items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: And that's the Celestans band. Then we had this boy Jewel Lawrence singing.

ctx.x: Well we had, on the rhythm section we had Leonard Mitchell playing guitar. We had Kimball, not Kimball, John Porter playing bass. And we had Kato playing piano. And that's the Celestans band. Then we had this boy Jewel Lawrence singing. You remember Jewel Lawrence? He used to play the song.
